notes: Right-click the timeline: copy, cut, paste, duplicate, speed, reverse, crop, mirror and extract audio, right where you need them.
Extract audio: pull a piece's sound onto its own Audio track, then tweak volume, fades, noise and voice clarity in the Sound panel.
Move your own footage: click it on the frame to drag it or resize it from a corner, like any overlay.
Help when a project won't load: a card explains what went wrong, gives steps, and a prompt to paste into Claude.
Tidier everywhere: compact New project and Folders sheets, no clipped names, copy buttons that flip to a tick, smoother Hub cards.
